newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends down vs dlr, firms vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends down vs dlr, firms vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed easier against the dollar, but firmed versus the central bank (NBH) currency basket, dealers said on Thursday.
The forint closed at 172.35/40, compared with 172.28/13 at the end of the morning session.
"The forint weakened due to the dollar's rise on international markets, " said Inter-Europa Bank's Ervin Csengeri.
But it firmed against the NBH's currency basket, which is made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark, closing the 10 pip gap below the NBH resistance level (bid).

Dealers said commercial orders and increased foreign currency supply, which may have been caused by exchange rate speculation encouraged by the sterling's strength, could push the forint to the NBH bid.
But the forint was likely to drift by some 10 pips away from the NBH bid again on Wednesday, dealers said.
Sterling futures firmed for all maturities on the Budapest Commodity Exchange. Dollar futures rose or remained steady, while mark futures closed lower or unchanged.
